items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Solid, secondary, outline, ghost, link and destructive buttons with a loading state and asChild for links.
items.docs: Use asChild to render the styles on a Next Link. loading disables the button and shows a spinner.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Status and metadata labels with success, warning, destructive, outline and muted tones.
items.docs: Status badges carry text as well as colour; never rely on the tone alone.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A loading placeholder in the shape of the content, with a shimmer sweep instead of a pulse. Give siblings a delay so the sweep runs as one wave.
items.docs: Match the real layout: a skeleton that does not hold the final shape shifts the page when the data arrives.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A hairline rule, horizontal or vertical, decorative by default.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A keyboard key for shortcut hints, with a group for combinations.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A text input with focus ring, invalid state and file input styling.
items.docs: Pair with Label via htmlFor. Set aria-invalid from your form library to show the error state.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: A form label that focuses its control on click.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A tooltip on hover and focus, with a shared provider so a row of controls feels like one surface.
items.docs: Wrap your app once in TooltipProvider. A tooltip is never the only place a label lives.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal dialog with focus trap, Escape and backdrop close, and a required title and description.
items.docs: Every DialogContent needs a DialogTitle; hide it visually with sr-only if the design has no heading.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel that slides in from any edge: menus, carts, filters. Same accessibility contract as Dialog.
items.docs: Pass side left, right, top or bottom. Sheets slide on transform only.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs with arrow-key navigation, as an underline (line) or a segmented control (pill).
items.docs: Give TabsList the group/list class so the triggers pick up the variant.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A filtered, keyboard-driven list on cmdk, inline or as a palette in CommandDialog.
items.docs: CommandDialog carries a hidden title and description for screen readers.

items.name: rhs-ui-theme
items.title: RHS UI theme
items.description: The RHS UI colour theme: a violet brand ramp on a constant OKLCH hue and a violet-tinted neutral scale, measured for WCAG AA in light and dark. Drops into any shadcn project as the semantic tokens.
items.docs: Installs the RHS semantic tokens into your globals.css. Your components keep their names (bg-background, text-primary); only the values change.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Keyboard-friendly disclosure rows with single or multiple expanded items.

items.name: accordion-demo
items.title: accordion demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the accordion component.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An accessible binary switch with form support and controlled or uncontrolled state.

items.name: switch-demo
items.title: switch demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the switch component.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: An accessible value or range slider with keyboard controls and labelled thumbs.

items.name: slider-demo
items.title: slider demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the slider component.

items.name: icons
items.title: Icons
items.description: The RHS UI icon set: one drawing hand for every glyph, a 1.75px stroke on a 24 grid with the open corner as its signature. Sized by size, coloured by currentColor, with Glyph to draw your own.
items.docs: Import the glyphs you need from "@rhs-ui/icons". Pass a title when an icon is the only label. Draw your own glyph in the same hand with <Glyph d="..." />.

items.name: animated-icon
items.title: Animated icon
items.description: The engine behind the animated icons: hover, focus, loop and first-view triggers through the Web Animations API, a two-state frame in plain CSS, and reduced motion respected. No animation library.
items.docs: Installed with every animated icon. Motion icons take trigger: hover (default, follows the button or link around the icon), loop, appear or static. State icons take active.

items.name: animated-icon-demo
items.title: Animated icon demo
items.description: Animated icons in buttons: a bell on hover, a refresh that loops while syncing, and a copy icon that turns into a check.

items.name: animated-bell
items.title: Animated bell
items.description: A bell that rings: the body swings from its crown and the clapper follows a beat later. For notifications and reminders.
items.docs: Inside a Button it rings when the button is hovered or focused. Use trigger="loop" while there are unread notifications.

items.name: animated-search
items.title: Animated search
items.description: A lens that looks left and right before it settles. For search, filter and lookup actions.
items.docs: Use trigger="loop" while results are loading.

items.name: animated-arrow-right
items.title: Animated arrow right
items.description: An arrow that leaves on the right and comes back in from the left. For continue, next and call-to-action buttons.
items.docs: Place it after the label: <Button>Continue <IconArrowRightAnimated /></Button>.

items.name: animated-heart
items.title: Animated heart
items.description: A heart that beats twice, the second beat softer than the first. For favourites, wishlists and likes.
items.docs: Pair it with aria-pressed on the wishlist button; the icon only shows the gesture.

items.name: animated-sparkle
items.title: Animated sparkle
items.description: A four-point star that turns a quarter and lands on itself while the small star pops back in. For new, highlight and AI states.
items.docs: Use trigger="loop" sparingly: one moving sparkle on a page is a highlight, three is noise.

items.name: animated-refresh
items.title: Animated refresh
items.description: One eased full turn on hover, or a steady loop while something syncs.
items.docs: Switch to trigger="loop" while syncing and set aria-busy on the button; it finishes its turn when you switch back.

items.name: animated-download
items.title: Animated download
items.description: The arrow drops through the tray and comes back from the top while the tray gives a little. For download and export actions.
items.docs: Inside a download link it plays on hover and on keyboard focus of the link.

items.name: animated-trash
items.title: Animated trash
items.description: The lid lifts from its left hinge and drops shut. For delete and remove actions.
items.docs: An icon-only delete button still needs an accessible label: <Button size="icon" aria-label="Delete">.

items.name: animated-send
items.title: Animated send
items.description: A paper plane that flies off to the top right and glides back in from the bottom left. For send, share and submit.
items.docs: Plays on hover and focus of the submit button it sits in.

items.name: animated-cart
items.title: Animated cart
items.description: A product drops into the basket and the cart dips under its weight. For add-to-cart buttons and cart links.
items.docs: At rest it is the cart glyph; the product only shows while it moves.

items.name: animated-check-circle
items.title: Animated check circle
items.description: The ring draws itself and then the check. For success states, best with trigger appear.
items.docs: <IconCheckCircleAnimated trigger="appear" /> draws once when a confirmation scrolls into view.

items.name: animated-copy
items.title: Animated copy
items.description: A copy icon that turns into a drawn check while active. For confirming a copy to the clipboard.
items.docs: Set active for a moment after navigator.clipboard.writeText resolves, and announce it in a live region.

items.name: animated-menu
items.title: Animated menu
items.description: Three lines that fold into a cross while active. For the open state of a navigation menu.
items.docs: Bind active to the menu's open state and aria-expanded on the button.

items.name: animated-sun-moon
items.title: Animated sun and moon
items.description: The sun draws in its rays and turns into the moon while active. For a light and dark theme switch.
items.docs: Bind active to the resolved theme after hydration, so the server and the first client render agree.

items.name: animated-settings
items.title: Animated settings
items.description: A gear that turns one tooth and settles while the hub gives a little. For settings and preferences.
items.docs: Inside a settings button it turns on hover and on keyboard focus. Use trigger="loop" while preferences are saving.

items.name: animated-mail
items.title: Animated mail
items.description: The flap folds open and a letter rises out before everything closes again. For mail, invites and messages.
items.docs: Use it in a contact or invite action; trigger="appear" plays it once when the section scrolls into view.

items.name: animated-upload
items.title: Animated upload
items.description: The arrow leaves through the top and comes back from the tray, which gives under it. For upload and import actions.
items.docs: Switch to trigger="loop" while a file is uploading and set aria-busy on the button.

items.name: animated-star
items.title: Animated star
items.description: A fifth of a turn lands the star back on itself, with a pop at the end. For ratings, favourites and highlights.
items.docs: Pair it with aria-pressed on a favourite button; the icon shows the gesture, the button holds the state.

items.name: animated-log-out
items.title: Animated log out
items.description: The arrow leaves through the door and comes back in behind it. For sign out and leave actions.
items.docs: Inside a sign-out button it plays on hover and on keyboard focus of that button.

items.name: animated-phone
items.title: Animated phone
items.description: A handset that rings: a shake that dies out. For call actions and contact details.
items.docs: Use trigger="loop" for an incoming call and stop the loop the moment it is answered.

items.name: animated-clock
items.title: Animated clock
items.description: Time passing: the minute hand makes two turns while the hour hand makes one. For schedules, history and timers.
items.docs: Use trigger="loop" while something is pending, or trigger="appear" on a history panel.

items.name: animated-message
items.title: Animated message
items.description: Three dots type inside the bubble and leave it empty again. For chat, comments and support.
items.docs: Use trigger="loop" as a typing indicator and announce the same thing in a live region.

items.name: animated-lock
items.title: Animated lock
items.description: A padlock that springs open. For locked and unlocked states.
items.docs: Set active when whatever it guards is unlocked, and mirror that in the button label or aria-pressed.

items.name: animated-eye
items.title: Animated eye
items.description: The eye closes behind a line that draws itself. For showing and hiding a password or a value.
items.docs: Set active when the content is hidden; the button label should change with it (Show password, Hide password).

items.name: animated-play-pause
items.title: Animated play and pause
items.description: Play turns into pause and back. For media and any start and stop control.
items.docs: Set active while something is playing, and keep the accessible name in step (Play, Pause).

items.name: animated-plus
items.title: Animated plus
items.description: A plus that turns an eighth of a turn into a close. For add buttons that open something.
items.docs: Bind active to the open state of the menu or panel it toggles, next to aria-expanded.

items.name: animated-bookmark
items.title: Animated bookmark
items.description: The ribbon fills and drops into place. For saving an item for later.
items.docs: Set active when the item is saved and use aria-pressed on the button around it.

items.name: product-card
items.title: Product card
items.description: A production product card for React and Next.js: image with hover zoom, sale and stock badges, compare-at price, colour swatches with radiogroup semantics, add to cart, and a matching skeleton.
items.docs: Pass a plain product object and handle onAddToCart; the card never fetches. Format prices before you pass them so the card stays locale-neutral. Use renderImage to plug in next/image.

items.name: product-card-demo
items.title: Product card demo
items.description: Two product cards: one on sale with colour variants, one sold out.

items.name: animated-price
items.title: Animated price
items.description: Currency-aware price transitions with the same soft count and blur across every price update.
items.docs: Data in, callbacks out. Locale defaults to en-US; pass your application locale explicitly. Reduced motion shows the final state immediately.

items.name: animated-price-demo
items.title: Animated price demo
items.description: An interactive example with real state changes and accessible controls.
